Name: Cold Brew
Description: Black, smooth and clean - 100 % arabica - naturally sweet & low in acidity
Ingredient:
90 ml classic concentrate
135 ml cold water 
ice cubes
Recipe:
1. Fill glass with ice cubes
2. Pour cold water
3. Slowly add classic cold brew 
4. Stir lightly for balanced flavor serve 
chilled

Name: Orange Cold Brew
Description: Bright and refreshing with zesty citrus and honey sweetness
Ingredient:
90 ml classic or bold concentrate 
30 ml orange juice
15 ml honey 
5 ml lemon juice  
90 ml soda 
ice cubes
Recipe:
1. Add some ice cubes to a glass or shaker 
2. Add orange juice, honey and lemon juice   
3. Top up with Chilld classic or bold concentrate
4. Stir or shake  
5. Pour chilled soda slowly

Name: Vietnamese cold brew
Description: A strong finish inspired by Vietnamese style coffee
Ingredient:
120 ml bold concentrate 
40 ml condensed milk 
ice cubes
Recipe:
1. Fill glass or shaker with a lot of ice cubes 
2. Add condensed milk 
3. Pour Chilld Bold concentrate on top
4. Close the shaker and shake vigourously. If making in a glass, then mix well with a stirer or hand blender 
5. Enjoy the creamy texture and a strong coffee flavour

Name: Cold Brew Martini
Description: The classic coffee cocktail in a smooth cold brew avatar
Ingredient:
75 ml classic or bold concentrate 
60 ml vodka
60 ml coffee liqueur 
10 ml simple syrup  
2 dashes of chocolate bitters  
ice cubes
Recipe:
1. Fill ice cubes in a shaker 
2. Add vodka 
3. Pour coffee liqueur 
4. Add Chilld bold concentrate
5. Add simple (sugar) syrup
6. Shaker to mix well
7. Pour into a martini glass over a strainer
8. Garnish with chocolate bitters
